title: Gaussian source disagreement region
statement: For each real number $\rho$, define the Gaussian source disagreement region to be the set of pairs $(u,v)\in\mathbb R^2$ such that $u\bigl(\rho u+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,v\bigr)<0$.
